What We Do

FULL-SERVICE OUTDOOR SOLUTIONS

Every project, big or small — handled by our experienced crew with precision and care.

Landscaping

Full-service landscape design and installation. Drought-tolerant plants, native species, irrigation systems, and complete garden transformations tailored to San Diego's climate.

Demolition

Safe, efficient removal of old structures, concrete, decks, and outdoor features. We handle everything from small patios to full yard demolition — clean and professional.

Paving

Beautiful, durable paving for driveways, walkways, and patios. Brick pavers, flagstone, travertine, and more — installed to last decades with expert craftsmanship.

Concrete

Stamped concrete, exposed aggregate, smooth finish — we pour and finish all concrete types. Driveways, patios, steps, retaining walls, and decorative flatwork.

Artificial Turf

Premium synthetic turf installation that looks and feels like real grass. Low-maintenance, pet-friendly, and water-saving — perfect for San Diego's drought conditions.

Junk Removal

Fast, responsible junk and debris removal. Garden waste, old furniture, construction material — we haul it all away so your property is cleared and ready for work.

Keystone Walls

Engineered retaining and decorative keystone walls that combine strength and beauty. Ideal for sloped yards, raised gardens, erosion control, and defining outdoor spaces.

Not Sure?

Every project starts with a conversation. Call us or fill out our quick quote form and we'll come out, assess your space, and give you an honest recommendation — no pressure.

How It Works

FROM QUOTE TO COMPLETION

01

Request a Free Quote

Fill out our quick form or give us a call. Tell us what you're looking for — we'll get back to you within 24 hours to schedule a site visit.

02

On-Site Assessment

Our team comes to your property, walks the space with you, understands your vision, and takes accurate measurements. No commitment, no pressure.

03

Detailed Proposal

You receive a clear, itemized written proposal with exact costs, materials, timeline, and scope. You'll know exactly what you're getting before signing anything.

04

We Get to Work

Our experienced crew arrives on schedule, works efficiently, and keeps your property clean throughout the project. We handle permits when required.

05

Final Walkthrough & Satisfaction

When the work is done, we walk through the finished project with you. We don't leave until you're 100% satisfied — that's our promise.
